item.description: Rigetti Computing (RGTI) trades near $15, about 73% below the high it set inside the past year. No market shock did that: the S&P 500 returned 17% over the past twelve months while Rigetti lost 8.5%. The 73% is measured from a high set inside those same twelve months, so the stock ran up hard before it fell. A fall like that in a rising market says the price is a bet on a road map.
